products.name: recipe
products.description: Detailed equipment-level process recipe defining all controllable parameters for a specific unit process step on a specific tool class. Captures recipe name, version, tool class, chamber configuration, and all process parameter setpoints organized by process type: implant conditions (species, energy, dose, tilt, twist, beam current, anneal recipe), deposition conditions (method such as LPCVD/PECVD/ALD/PVD/EPI, target material, thickness, temperature, pressure, precursor flows, RF power, deposition rate, uniformity spec), etch conditions (type, chemistry, gas flows, pressure, RF source/bias power, etch rate, selectivity, CD bias, endpoint detection), CMP conditions (slurry, pad, platen pressure, carrier speed, table speed, endpoint detection, removal target, post-CMP clean, uniformity spec), and lithography conditions (scanner, wavelength, NA, sigma, illumination mode, resist type/thickness, exposure dose, focus offset, develop process, bake temperatures, OPC rule set reference). Includes recipe approval status, effective date range, qualification linkage, and full revision history. Sourced from Applied Materials SmartFactory MES and Camstar MES recipe management modules. SSOT for ALL equipment-level process parameters and conditions; no separate condition products exist — all process-type-specific parameters are attributes within this unified recipe entity.

products.name: spc_control_chart
products.description: Statistical Process Control (SPC) control chart definition and complete measurement history for a monitored process parameter at a specific process step. Chart definition captures chart type (Xbar-R, Xbar-S, EWMA, CUSUM, IMR), monitored parameter name, control limits (UCL, LCL, UWL, LWL), target value, sample size, sampling frequency, chart owner, and current chart status. Measurement detail (header+line pattern) captures all individual data points: measured value, measurement timestamp, lot reference, wafer number, site coordinates, measurement tool ID, chart rule violations triggered (Western Electric rules, Nelson rules), and resulting process action (none, warning, OCAP triggered). Implements SEMI E10 and JEDEC SPC guidelines. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools. SSOT for all SPC monitoring definitions and measurement data in the process domain.

attributes.name: chart_name

attributes.name: chart_type

attributes.name: control_limit_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the control limits for this SPC chart. Three sigma uses standard deviation-based limits; six sigma uses tighter limits; Cpk-based derives limits from process capability index; historical baseline uses past performance data; engineering specification uses design requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 SPC Guidelines, JEDEC Statistical Process Control Standards

attributes.name: process_capability_index_cp
attributes.description: Process capability index Cp, calculated as (USL - LSL) / (6 * sigma). Measures the potential capability of the process to meet specifications, assuming the process is centered. Values > 1.33 are typically considered acceptable.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 SPC Guidelines, JEDEC Statistical Process Control Standards

attributes.name: process_capability_index_cpk
attributes.description: Process capability index Cpk, calculated as min[(USL - mean) / (3 * sigma), (mean - LSL) / (3 * sigma)]. Measures the actual capability of the process to meet specifications, accounting for process centering. Values > 1.33 are typically considered acceptable.
attributes.references: SEMI E10 SPC Guidelines, JEDEC Statistical Process Control Standards

Sourced from KLA 29xx/39xx series and Applied Materials SEMVision.

attributes.description: Type of inspection technology used: brightfield scanner, darkfield scanner, e-beam inspection, optical inspection, or macro inspection.

attributes.name: killer_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as killer defects (defects large enough or critical enough to cause die failure).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Name of the process layer being inspected (e.g., Metal1, Poly, Contact, Via2). Identifies the fabrication layer in the stack.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inspection results, anomalies, or follow-up actions required.

attributes.name: nuisance_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as nuisance (false positives or non-yield-impacting detections filtered by nuisance filter).

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a nuisance filter was applied to remove false positives or non-critical defects from the reported count.

attributes.name: nuisance_filter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the nuisance filter algorithm or rule set applied during this inspection.

attributes.name: particle_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as particles (foreign material on wafer surface).

attributes.name: pattern_defect_count

attributes.name: residue_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as residue (chemical or material residue remaining after processing).

attributes.name: review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether engineering review is required based on defect count, type, or pattern analysis.

attributes.name: review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the engineering review was completed.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineer who reviewed the inspection results, if review was performed.

attributes.name: scratch_defect_count
attributes.description: Number of defects classified as scratches (linear surface damage).

attributes.name: total_defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects detected on the wafer during this inspection, including all defect types and sizes.

products.name: metrology_measurement
products.description: In-line metrology measurement record capturing critical dimension (CD), overlay, film thickness, resistivity, or other physical parameter measurements taken on a wafer at a specific process step. Captures measurement type (CD-SEM, OCD, XRF, ellipsometry, overlay), tool ID, wafer lot reference, wafer number, measurement site map, per-site values, mean, 3-sigma, range, and pass/fail disposition against spec limits. Sourced from KLA ICOS and in-line metrology tools.
products.reference: SEMI M1 / KLA Metrology / CD-SEM SEMI E89

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id

attributes.name: tool_chamber_id

attributes.name: wafer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific wafer within the lot that was measured.

attributes.name: cp_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cp) calculated from this measurement, indicating the potential capability of the process without considering centering.

attributes.name: cpk_value
attributes.description: Process capability index (Cpk) calculated from this measurement, indicating how well the process is centered and controlled within specification limits.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating the quality and reliability of the measurement data. Good indicates reliable data, Suspect indicates questionable data, Bad indicates invalid data, Uncalibrated indicates tool calibration issue.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Pass/fail disposition of the measurement against specification limits. Pass indicates within spec, Fail indicates out of spec, Marginal indicates near limits, Rework indicates corrective action required, Hold indicates pending review.

attributes.name: fab_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the fabrication facility where the measurement was performed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: layer_name

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values below this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: lower_spec_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values below this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: max_value
attributes.description: Maximum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: mean_value
attributes.description: Arithmetic mean of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: measurement_mode
attributes.description: Mode in which the measurement was performed. Inline indicates production flow measurement, Offline indicates lab measurement, Engineering indicates development measurement, Qualification indicates process qualification.

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: Specific physical parameter being measured (e.g., critical dimension, overlay X/Y, film thickness, resistivity, reflectivity).

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Status of the measurement execution. Completed indicates successful measurement, In Progress indicates measurement underway, Failed indicates measurement error, Aborted indicates user-terminated, Pending indicates queued.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the metrology measurement was performed.

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: Type of metrology measurement performed: CD-SEM (Critical Dimension Scanning Electron Microscopy), OCD (Optical Critical Dimension), XRF (X-Ray Fluorescence), Ellipsometry, Overlay, or Film Thickness.

attributes.name: median_value
attributes.description: Median value of all site measurements for this parameter.

attributes.name: min_value
attributes.description: Minimum measured value across all sites on the wafer.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the measurement, including any anomalies, special conditions, or operator observations.

attributes.name: range_value
attributes.description: Difference between maximum and minimum site measurements (max - min).

attributes.name: site_count
attributes.description: Total number of measurement sites sampled on the wafer.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violation
attributes.description: Description of any SPC rule violations detected (e.g., Western Electric rules, Nelson rules) such as trend, shift, or out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: std_deviation
attributes.description: Standard deviation (1-sigma) of the site measurements, indicating within-wafer uniformity.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target or nominal value for this measurement parameter as defined by the process specification.

attributes.name: three_sigma
attributes.description: Three times the standard deviation, representing the process variation range.

attributes.name: uniformity_percent
attributes.description: Within-wafer uniformity expressed as a percentage, calculated as (range / mean) * 100 or (3-sigma / mean) * 100 depending on convention.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the measurement values (e.g., nm, angstrom, ohm-cm, percent).

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit for Statistical Process Control (SPC) monitoring. Values above this trigger investigation.

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for this measurement parameter. Values above this threshold fail specification.

attributes.name: wafer_slot_number
attributes.description: Position of the wafer within the lot carrier or cassette.

products.name: excursion
products.description: Process excursion record capturing any significant out-of-spec, out-of-control, or yield-impacting condition detected during wafer manufacturing that requires formal engineering investigation. Encompasses all yield loss events as a unified excursion type. Captures excursion detection source (SPC, inspection, metrology, electrical test), affected lot list, process step, excursion severity (minor/major/critical), yield loss mode (parametric, systematic, random, electrical), defect density, affected die count, estimated yield impact, detection timestamp, containment actions taken, root cause category, corrective action reference, investigation status, and final disposition. Serves as the single parent investigation record for all process-related yield and excursion events. Distinct from individual OCAP actions which are the immediate corrective responses. SSOT for process excursion and yield loss tracking; quality domain owns outgoing quality excursions and customer returns.

Direct FK from excursion to inventory_wafer_lot drives lot containment workflows and excursion

Process engineers and quality teams use this link in MRB workflows to trace every excursion to its NCR.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_step. Business justification: A process excursion occurs at a specific process step (e.g., etch rate excursion at metal etch step, overlay excursion at lithography step). Linking excursion to process_step is essential for process

attributes.name: affected_die_count
attributes.description: Estimated total number of die units affected by this excursion. Used for financial impact assessment and customer notification.

attributes.name: affected_lot_count
attributes.description: Total number of wafer lots affected by this excursion event. Used for impact assessment and containment scope determination.

attributes.name: affected_wafer_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual wafers affected by this excursion across all lots. Used for yield impact calculation.

attributes.name: containment_action_taken
attributes.description: Immediate containment actions taken upon excursion detection. Describes steps such as lot hold, equipment quarantine, process parameter adjustment, or rework initiation.

attributes.name: containment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when containment actions were completed. Used to measure response time and containment effectiveness.

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the corrective action plan. Links to the formal corrective and preventive action (CAPA) system or Out-of-Control Action Plan (OCAP) record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this excursion record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer notification is required for this excursion. True if the excursion impacts shipped product or customer-specific quality requirements.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when customer was notified of the excursion. Used for compliance tracking and customer relationship management.

attributes.name: defect_density_per_cm2
attributes.description: Measured defect density in defects per square centimeter for the affected wafers. Key metric for yield impact assessment.

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: Source system or method that detected the excursion event. Indicates whether the excursion was identified through Statistical Process Control (SPC), inspection, metrology measurement, electrical test, operator observation, or automated monitoring system.

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the excursion was first detected. Represents the business event time of excursion identification.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the affected material. Determines whether lots are released, reworked, scrapped, returned, or require additional review.

attributes.name: disposition_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final disposition decision was made. Marks the completion of the excursion investigation and material release decision.

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact_usd
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact of the excursion in US dollars. Includes scrap cost, rework cost, yield loss, and potential customer claims.

attributes.name: estimated_yield_impact_percent
attributes.description: Estimated percentage point impact on wafer yield due to this excursion. Calculated based on defect density, affected area, and historical correlation data.

attributes.name: excursion_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the excursion event. Human-readable reference number used for tracking and communication across engineering teams.

attributes.name: excursion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the excursion event. Categorizes whether the excursion is due to out-of-specification parameters, out-of-control process conditions, yield loss, excessive defect density, parametric drift, or equipment fault.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the excursion investigation. Tracks progression from initial detection through root cause analysis to closure.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this excursion record was last updated. Audit trail for tracking investigation progress and status changes.

attributes.name: lower_control_limit
attributes.description: Lower control limit from the Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart at the time of excursion detection. Used to determine out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: Actual measured value of the parameter that triggered the excursion. Used for root cause analysis and process capability assessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations related to the excursion investigation. Captures engineering insights and lessons learned.

attributes.name: owner_organization
attributes.description: Engineering organization or department responsible for this excursion. Examples include Process Integration, Lithography, Etch, Thin Films, or Metrology.

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the process parameter that triggered the excursion. Examples include critical dimension (CD), film thickness, overlay, resistance, or other measured characteristics.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause. Categories include equipment malfunction, material variation, process recipe issue, human error, environmental condition, or unknown pending investigation.

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the identified root cause. Captures engineering analysis findings and technical explanation of the excursion mechanism.

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the excursion impact. Minor excursions require monitoring, major excursions require corrective action, and critical excursions require immediate containment and investigation.

attributes.name: spc_rule_violated
attributes.description: Specific Statistical Process Control (SPC) rule that was violated to trigger the excursion. Examples include Western Electric rules, Nelson rules, or custom fab-specific control rules.

attributes.name: specification_lower_limit
attributes.description: Lower specification limit for the parameter. Used to determine out-of-specification conditions and product quality impact.

attributes.name: specification_upper_limit
attributes.description: Upper specification limit for the parameter. Used to determine out-of-specification conditions and product quality impact.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Target specification value for the parameter. Used to calculate deviation magnitude and assess excursion severity.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the parameter values. Examples include nanometers (nm), angstroms, ohms, degrees Celsius, or other engineering units.

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Upper control limit from the Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart at the time of excursion detection. Used to determine out-of-control conditions.

attributes.name: yield_loss_mode
attributes.description: Classification of the yield loss mechanism. Parametric indicates parameter drift, systematic indicates repeatable pattern defects, random indicates sporadic defects, electrical indicates functional test failures, none indicates no yield impact detected.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Authoritative semiconductor product catalog encompassing ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, IP cores, and discrete devices. SSOT for product specifications, SKUs, BOM, process node assignments, PPA metrics, product lifecycle status (NPI through EOL), PCN management, and LTB notifications. Integrates with PLM systems.

products.name: ic_catalog
products.description: Master record for all semiconductor products (ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, licensable IP cores). SSOT for product identity, internal/external part numbers, product family assignment, process node, target market, and lifecycle state with full NPI→qualification→production→EOL transition history. Golden record integrated with PLM. Each entry represents a unique silicon design with one or more orderable SKU variants.

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IC catalog entry. Primary key for the master record of semiconductor products including ICs, SoCs, ASICs, FPGAs, discretes, and licensable IP cores.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family.product_family_id — Every IC product belongs to a product family in the taxonomy hierarchy. This is the primary classification FK.

attributes.name: ic_family_id
attributes.description: FK to product.product_family

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Every IC catalog entry has a corresponding material master in semiconductor ERP for procurement and inventory management. This link enables direct MRP consumption from catalog, cost accounting, and su

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Procurement process requires linking each IC catalog entry to its primary supplier for sourcing, cost analysis, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: aec_qualification_level
attributes.description: Specific AEC qualification standard met. Q100: ICs, Q101: Discretes, Q102: Optoelectronics, Q200: Passives. Set to NA if not automotive qualified.

attributes.name: automotive_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has passed automotive-grade qualification testing per AEC-Q standards. Required for automotive market. Includes extended temperature, reliability, and quality requirements.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the IC was manufactured or substantially transformed. Used for trade compliance, tariffs, and country-of-origin marking requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was first created in the PLM system. Audit trail for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Design methodology used for IC development. Determines NRE cost, time to market, and flexibility. Full custom offers maximum optimization; standard cell balances speed and cost.

attributes.name: die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Physical die area in square millimeters after final layout. Critical cost driver as it determines dies per wafer and manufacturing yield economics. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
attributes.description: ECCN code assigned under US Export Administration Regulations. Determines export licensing requirements for dual-use items. Format: 3A001.a. EAR99 indicates no specific ECCN.

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL was formally announced to customers via Product Change Notification (PCN). Triggers last-time-buy (LTB) planning and customer transition activities.

attributes.name: first_silicon_date
attributes.description: Date when first fabricated silicon wafers were received from the fab for initial testing and validation. Marks start of silicon bring-up phase.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule classification code for customs and import duty determination. Format: 8542.31.0000 for electronic integrated circuits.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catalog entry is currently active and available for business operations. False indicates archived or soft-deleted record retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related articles. True if product requires US State Department export license for international shipment.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when product shipments will be made. Marks complete discontinuation of the product. Typically 6-12 months after last-time-buy date to allow for manufacturing lead time.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders before product is discontinued. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement. After this date, no new orders are accepted.

attributes.name: lead_free_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets RoHS (Restriction of Hazardous Substances) lead-free requirements. True if compliant with EU RoHS Directive for lead-free solder and materials.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). Governs manufacturing, sales, and support activities. Transitions tracked in status history. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NPI|Qualification|Production|Mature|EOL_Announced|EOL_Active|Obsolete — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IC catalog record was last updated. Tracks data currency and change history for audit and synchronization purposes.

attributes.name: npi_phase
attributes.description: Detailed phase within NPI lifecycle for products in pre-production stages. Tracks progress from concept through design, tapeout, silicon bring-up, and qualification. Set to NA for production products. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Concept|Design|Tapeout|Silicon_Validation|Qualification|Ramp|Production|NA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operating_frequency_max_mhz
attributes.description: Maximum clock frequency in MHz at which the IC can reliably operate. Key performance metric for processors, SoCs, and high-speed digital circuits. Part of PPA metrics.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_max_v
attributes.description: Maximum supply voltage in volts for safe operation. Defines upper bound of operating voltage range. Exceeding this may cause device damage or reliability issues.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_min_v
attributes.description: Minimum supply voltage in volts for guaranteed operation. Defines lower bound of operating voltage range for power optimization and battery operation.

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of external pins or balls on the package. Determines PCB routing complexity, package cost, and I/O capability.

attributes.name: power_max_mw
attributes.description: Maximum power consumption in milliwatts under worst-case operating conditions. Used for thermal design, power supply sizing, and system integration planning.

attributes.name: power_typical_mw
attributes.description: Typical operating power consumption in milliwatts under nominal conditions. Critical PPA metric for mobile, IoT, and battery-powered applications. Measured at specified voltage and frequency.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Underlying semiconductor process technology architecture. Examples: CMOS (Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor), FinFET (Fin Field-Effect Transistor), GAA (Gate All Around), BiCMOS (Bipolar CMOS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CMOS|FinFET|GAA|BiCMOS|SOI|GaN|SiGe — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the IC product used in customer communications, datasheets, and sales collateral.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the semiconductor product type. Determines design flow, manufacturing process, and business model (silicon vs. licensable IP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|IP_Core|Discrete|Memory|Analog|Mixed_Signal|RF — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: production_release_date
attributes.description: Date when product was officially released to production status and made available for volume manufacturing and customer orders. Marks end of qualification phase.

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates compliance with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation. Confirms no Substances of Very High Concern (SVHC) above threshold.

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates full compliance with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE). Required for European market access.

attributes.name: rtl_language
attributes.description: Hardware description language used for RTL design specification. Verilog and SystemVerilog are industry standard for digital design. Set to NA for analog-only or IP-only products.

attributes.name: tapeout_date
attributes.description: Date when final GDSII design database was released to the fab for mask generation and wafer fabrication. Marks completion of design phase and start of manufacturing.

attributes.name: target_market
attributes.description: Primary market segment or application domain for which the IC is designed. Determines qualification requirements, reliability standards, and regulatory compliance needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Consumer|Industrial|Medical|Aerospace|Defense|Telecom|Computing|IoT|AI_ML — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Temperature range classification determining qualified operating environment. Commercial: 0-70C, Industrial: -40-85C, Automotive: -40-125C, Military: -55-125C. Critical for market qualification.

attributes.name: transistor_count
attributes.description: Total number of transistors on the die. Key complexity metric for digital ICs and SoCs. Used for design effort estimation and manufacturing complexity assessment.

products.name: sku
products.description: Stock-keeping unit records representing orderable, shippable variants of catalog products. Each SKU captures the specific combination of package type, speed grade, temperature range, voltage variant, and qualification level (commercial, industrial, automotive AEC-Q100/Q101) that constitutes a distinct orderable item. Links to ic_catalog for the parent product definition and to inventory for stock tracking.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock keeping unit record. Primary key for the SKU entity representing a distinct orderable variant of a catalog product.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: SKUs are the orderable units that correspond directly to material master records in semiconductor ERP systems. Each SKU maps to a material master for procurement, inventory valuation, and MRP demand p

attributes.name: primary_sku_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product definition in the IC catalog. Links this SKU to the base product design and specification.

attributes.name: replacement_sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recommended replacement SKU for customers when this SKU reaches end of life. Facilitates design migration and continuity planning.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Every SKU is an orderable variant of a catalog product. This is the most fundamental FK in the domain — without it, SKUs are orphaned from their parent product definition.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-facing unique alphanumeric code identifying this orderable SKU variant. Used in customer orders, invoices, and supply chain documentation.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the country where final manufacturing or substantial transformation occurred. Required for customs documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: Optional customer-specific part number assigned to this SKU for custom or design-win scenarios. Facilitates customer BOM alignment.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Customer Material Info

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: US Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) Export Administration Regulations (EAR) classification code. Determines export licensing requirements.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when Product Change Notification (PCN) was issued announcing the end of life for this SKU. Triggers Last Time Buy (LTB) planning for customers.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: halogen_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is manufactured without halogen-containing materials (chlorine, bromine compounds). Required for certain environmental certifications.

attributes.name: hts_code
attributes.description: International customs classification code for tariff and duty calculation. Used for cross-border shipments and trade compliance.

attributes.name: introduction_date
attributes.description: Date when this SKU was first made available for customer orders. Marks the transition from NPI to Active lifecycle status.

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is subject to US ITAR export controls for defense articles. Requires special licensing and handling procedures.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SKU record was most recently updated. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.name: last_ship_date
attributes.description: Final date when shipments of this SKU will be fulfilled. Marks the end of product availability and transition to discontinued status.

attributes.name: last_time_buy_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders for this SKU before discontinuation. Typically 6-12 months after EOL announcement.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: lead_time_weeks
attributes.description: Typical manufacturing and delivery lead time in weeks from order placement to shipment. Subject to capacity allocation and supply chain conditions.
attributes.references: SAP Production Planning (PP) Lead Time Scheduling

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current stage in the product lifecycle. NPI (New Product Introduction), Active (full production), Mature (stable demand), Declining (phase-out), EOL Announced (End of Life notice issued), Discontinued (no longer available).

attributes.name: list_price_usd
attributes.description: Published list price in US dollars for this SKU at 1000-unit quantity. Actual transaction prices subject to volume discounts and customer agreements.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Pricing Conditions

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Smallest quantity that can be ordered for this SKU in a single purchase order line. Driven by packaging constraints and economic order quantities.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Sales Unit

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity classification indicating required storage and handling conditions before reflow soldering. MSL1 (unlimited floor life) to MSL6 (mandatory bake before use). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSL1|MSL2|MSL2a|MSL3|MSL4|MSL5|MSL5a|MSL6 — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: orderable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently available for new customer orders. May be false during allocation, quality holds, or phase-out periods.
attributes.references: SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Material Status

attributes.name: pcn_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any changes to this SKU specification, manufacturing process, or supply chain require formal Product Change Notification (PCN) to customers per contractual or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP131 Product Change Notification Standards

attributes.name: pin_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical pins or balls on the package. Critical for PCB design and routing complexity assessment.

attributes.name: qualification_level
attributes.description: Reliability and qualification standard met by this SKU. AEC-Q100 for automotive ICs, AEC-Q101 for discrete automotive, MIL-STD-883 for military/aerospace.
attributes.references: AEC-Q100 Automotive Qualification, AEC-Q101 Discrete Qualification, MIL-STD-883 Military Standards

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and disclosure.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU meets EU RoHS directive requirements for restricted substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, PBDE).

attributes.name: shippable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is currently authorized for shipment. May be false during quality holds, regulatory blocks, or export restrictions.

attributes.name: speed_grade
attributes.description: Performance binning classification indicating maximum operating frequency or timing specification. Higher grades command premium pricing.

attributes.name: standard_cost_usd
attributes.description: Fully-loaded standard manufacturing cost in US dollars including wafer fabrication, assembly, test, and allocated overhead. Used for margin analysis and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: standard_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units in a standard shipping container (tape and reel, tray, tube). Orders are typically placed in multiples of this quantity.
attributes.references: JEDEC JEP113 Tape and Reel Standards

attributes.name: temperature_range
attributes.description: Qualified operating temperature range classification. Commercial (0-70C), Industrial (-40-85C), Automotive (-40-125C), Military (-55-125C), Extended (-40-105C).

attributes.name: unit_weight_grams
attributes.description: Weight of a single packaged unit in grams. Used for shipping cost calculation and logistics planning.

attributes.name: voltage_variant
attributes.description: Core or I/O voltage specification variant for this SKU. Defines power supply requirements and compatibility with system voltage rails.

products.name: family
products.description: Hierarchical grouping of related IC products into product families and sub-families (e.g., Cortex-class SoCs, automotive MCU family, RF transceiver family). Manages the multi-level product taxonomy used for roadmap planning, pricing strategy, and customer design-in targeting. Supports up to five levels of hierarchy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant.

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product family. Primary key for the product family entity.

attributes.name: parent_family_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product family in the hierarchy. Supports multi-level taxonomy: portfolio → family → sub-family → product → variant. Null for top-level portfolio entries.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: Product families are manufactured at specific foundry/fab suppliers. Family-level supplier assignment drives NPI planning, capacity allocation, and technology roadmap decisions. fab_site_code and osat

attributes.name: active_pcn_count
attributes.description: Number of active PCNs currently in effect for this product family. Indicates ongoing changes to process, materials, or design that require customer notification and approval.

attributes.name: application_domain
attributes.description: Specific application domain or use case this product family addresses (e.g., Advanced Driver Assistance Systems, Edge AI Inference, 5G Baseband Processing). Used for technical marketing and customer solution mapping.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or division responsible for this product family (e.g., Automotive Solutions, Mobile Computing, IoT and Embedded). Aligns with organizational structure and P&L responsibility.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the product family in external systems and customer communications. Used in PLM, ERP, and CRM systems for product taxonomy navigation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product family record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the product family including target applications, key features, and market positioning. Used for technical documentation and sales enablement.

attributes.name: design_center_location
attributes.description: Primary design center location responsible for this product family (e.g., San Jose CA, Austin TX, Bangalore India). Used for resource planning and IP ownership tracking.

attributes.name: dfm_score
attributes.description: Design for Manufacturability score (0-100) indicating how well the product family design aligns with manufacturing best practices. Higher scores correlate with better yield and lower manufacturing risk.

attributes.name: dft_coverage_percent
attributes.description: Design for Testability coverage percentage indicating the proportion of circuit nodes accessible for ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation). Higher coverage enables better defect detection during wafer test.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family was fully discontinued and removed from active catalog. No further production or shipments after this date.

attributes.name: ear_eccn_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) Code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number under US EAR regulations. Defines export licensing requirements for dual-use technology. Format: category (0-9), product group (A-E), reason for control (001-999).
attributes.references: EAR 15 CFR Part 774 - Commerce Control List

tag_set.value: Export Administration Regulations (EAR) Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) Code

attributes.name: eda_tool_suite
attributes.description: Primary EDA tool suite used for design and verification of this product family (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso/Innovus, Synopsys Design Compiler/IC Compiler). Defines design methodology and tool licensing requirements.

attributes.name: eol_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when EOL was announced to customers via PCN (Product Change Notification). Triggers LTB (Last Time Buy) planning and customer migration activities.

attributes.name: family_type
attributes.description: Classification of the product family by semiconductor device type. Aligns with industry standard device categories for design, fabrication, and test planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IC|SoC|ASIC|FPGA|IP_Core|Discrete|Mixed_Signal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the product family hierarchy (1=portfolio, 2=family, 3=sub-family, 4=product, 5=variant). Supports up to five levels of product taxonomy as defined in the product domain.

attributes.name: ip_core_count
attributes.description: Number of reusable IP cores integrated into products in this family. Indicates design complexity and IP licensing requirements. Used for NRE (Non-Recurring Engineering) cost estimation.

attributes.name: itar_controlled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family is subject to ITAR export controls for defense-related technology. Restricts international sales and requires export licensing.

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product family record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle stage of the product family: Concept (early planning), NPI (New Product Introduction), Active (volume production), Mature (stable production), Phase_Out (declining), EOL (End of Life announced), Discontinued (no longer available). Drives supply chain and customer communication strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Concept|NPI|Active|Mature|Phase_Out|EOL|Discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Photolithography technology used for patterning (EUV Extreme Ultraviolet, DUV Deep Ultraviolet). Impacts design complexity, mask costs, and fab capability requirements.

attributes.name: ltb_date
attributes.description: Final date for customers to place orders before product family is discontinued. Part of EOL process and customer lifecycle management.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this product family record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Business name of the product family (e.g., Cortex-M Series, Automotive MCU Family, RF Transceiver Family). Used in roadmap planning, marketing materials, and customer design-in targeting.

attributes.name: npi_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family entered NPI phase. Marks the beginning of qualification, ramp, and early customer shipments. Used for TTM (Time to Market) tracking.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Primary packaging technology for this product family (e.g., WLCSP Wafer-Level Chip Scale Package, BGA Ball Grid Array, QFN Quad Flat No-Lead, CoWoS Chip on Wafer on Substrate, InFO Integrated Fan-Out). Defines assembly process and thermal/electrical characteristics.

attributes.name: pdk_version
attributes.description: Version of the Process Design Kit used for this product family. PDK contains design rules, device models, and technology files required for IC design. Critical for design-to-manufacturing alignment.

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process node in nanometers (e.g., 5, 7, 14, 28). Defines the manufacturing technology generation and impacts PPA (Power Performance Area) characteristics. Critical for fab capacity planning and yield modeling.

attributes.name: process_technology
attributes.description: Transistor architecture technology used in the process node (FinFET, GAA Gate All Around, Planar, FD-SOI Fully Depleted Silicon On Insulator). Determines electrical characteristics and design rules.

attributes.name: product_line_manager
attributes.description: Name of the product line manager responsible for roadmap, positioning, and lifecycle management of this product family. Business owner for strategic decisions.

attributes.name: qualification_standard
attributes.description: Industry qualification standard this product family must meet (e.g., AEC-Q100 for automotive, MIL-STD-883 for military, JEDEC JESD47 for stress testing). Defines reliability testing requirements.

attributes.name: reach_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family complies with EU REACH Regulation for chemical substance safety. Required for European market sales and supply chain transparency.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: rohs_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product family is designed to comply with EU RoHS Directive restricting hazardous substances in electronic equipment. Critical for European market access.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: target_market_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment this product family targets. Used for roadmap planning, pricing strategy, and customer design-in targeting. Aligns with business unit structure and go-to-market strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Computing|Mobile|Automotive|AI_ML|IoT|Industrial|Consumer|Networking|Data_Center — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_performance_metric
attributes.description: Key performance metric and target value for this product family (e.g., 3.5 GHz clock frequency, 100 TOPS AI performance, 10 Gbps throughput). Used for competitive analysis and roadmap planning.

attributes.name: target_power_mw
attributes.description: Target typical power consumption in milliwatts for this product family. Part of PPA (Power Performance Area) metrics used for competitive positioning and customer design-in evaluation.

attributes.name: target_yield_percent
attributes.description: Target manufacturing yield percentage (good dies per wafer) for this product family at volume production. Used for cost modeling, capacity planning, and fab performance tracking.

attributes.name: typical_die_size_mm2
attributes.description: Representative die size in square millimeters for products in this family. Used for wafer yield modeling, cost estimation, and capacity planning. Actual die sizes may vary by specific product variant.

attributes.name: volume_production_date
attributes.description: Date when this product family achieved volume production status (Active lifecycle). Indicates full manufacturing qualification and capacity availability.

products.name: product_spec
products.description: Detailed electrical, functional, and PPA (Power-Performance-Area) specifications for each IC product at given operating condition corners. Covers operating voltage range, temperature range, I/O count, interface protocols, memory configuration, security features, functional safety ratings (ISO 26262 ASIL, IEC 61508 SIL), plus target and achieved values for dynamic power, leakage power, maximum frequency, and die area. Supports multi-corner characterization and competitive PPA benchmarking.

attributes.name: product_spec_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product specification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_product_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, IP core, or discrete device) for which this specification applies.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification was formally approved for release to manufacturing or customers.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the engineering authority who approved this specification for release.

attributes.name: automotive_grade
attributes.description: AEC-Q100 automotive qualification grade indicating temperature range and reliability requirements (Grade 0: -40°C to 150°C, Grade 1: -40°C to 125°C, Grade 2: -40°C to 105°C, Grade 3: -40°C to 85°C).
attributes.references: AEC-Q100 - Failure Mechanism Based Stress Test Qualification for Integrated Circuits

attributes.name: characterization_date
attributes.description: Date when this specification was characterized and validated through silicon testing or simulation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product specification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_retention_years
attributes.description: Guaranteed data retention period in years for non-volatile memory components at specified temperature.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 - Stress-Test-Driven Qualification of Integrated Circuits

attributes.name: die_area_achieved_mm2
attributes.description: Actual measured silicon die area in square millimeters (mm²) from physical layout. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 - Specifications for Polished Monocrystalline Silicon Wafers

attributes.name: die_area_target_mm2
attributes.description: Target silicon die area in square millimeters (mm²). Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 - Specifications for Polished Monocrystalline Silicon Wafers

attributes.name: dynamic_power_achieved_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized dynamic power consumption in milliwatts (mW) during active switching operation at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: dynamic_power_target_mw
attributes.description: Target dynamic power consumption in milliwatts (mW) during active switching operation at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: endurance_cycles
attributes.description: Number of program/erase cycles guaranteed for non-volatile memory components (applicable to flash, EEPROM).
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 - Stress-Test-Driven Qualification of Integrated Circuits

attributes.name: esd_protection_level_kv
attributes.description: Electrostatic discharge protection rating in kilovolts (kV) per JEDEC standards (e.g., HBM, CDM models).

attributes.name: functional_safety_rating
attributes.description: Functional safety certification level achieved by the product. ISO 26262 ASIL (Automotive Safety Integrity Level) A through D for automotive applications; IEC 61508 SIL (Safety Integrity Level) 1 through 4 for industrial applications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|iso_26262_asil_a|iso_26262_asil_b|iso_26262_asil_c|iso_26262_asil_d|iec_61508_sil_1|iec_61508_sil_2|iec_61508_sil_3|iec_61508_sil_4 — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 26262 - Automotive Functional Safety, IEC 61508 - Functional Safety of Electrical Systems

attributes.name: gate_count
attributes.description: Total number of logic gates (or gate equivalents) in the design, representing design complexity.

attributes.name: interface_protocols
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of supported communication interface protocols (e.g., PCIe, USB, DDR4, MIPI, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet).

attributes.name: io_count
attributes.description: Total number of input/output pins or pads available on the integrated circuit for signal connectivity.

attributes.name: leakage_power_achieved_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized static leakage power consumption in milliwatts (mW) when the circuit is idle at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: leakage_power_target_mw
attributes.description: Target static leakage power consumption in milliwatts (mW) when the circuit is idle at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: max_frequency_achieved_mhz
attributes.description: Actual measured or characterized maximum operating frequency in megahertz (MHz) at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: max_frequency_target_mhz
attributes.description: Target maximum operating frequency in megahertz (MHz) at nominal conditions. Part of PPA (Power-Performance-Area) metrics.

attributes.name: memory_configuration
attributes.description: Description of on-chip memory architecture including SRAM, cache, ROM, and embedded flash sizes and organization (e.g., 256KB L2 Cache, 2MB SRAM, 512KB ROM).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this product specification record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, caveats, or clarifications regarding this product specification, including test conditions, measurement methodology, or known limitations.

attributes.name: operating_condition_corner
attributes.description: Process-voltage-temperature (PVT) corner at which this specification is characterized. Typical represents nominal conditions; best/worst case represent performance extremes; slow/fast combinations represent process variation corners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: typical|best_case|worst_case|slow_slow|fast_fast|slow_fast|fast_slow — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: operating_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum junction temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum junction temperature in degrees Celsius at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_max_v
attributes.description: Maximum operating voltage in volts (V) at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_min_v
attributes.description: Minimum operating voltage in volts (V) at which the product is guaranteed to function within specification.

attributes.name: operating_voltage_nominal_v
attributes.description: Nominal (typical) operating voltage in volts (V) for standard operation.

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type and form factor (e.g., BGA, QFN, WLCSP, LGA, SOIC, DIP, CoWoS, InFO).

attributes.name: process_node_nm
attributes.description: Semiconductor fabrication process technology node in nanometers (nm), representing the minimum feature size (e.g., 7, 5, 3).

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction.

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product meets EU RoHS directive requirements for restriction of hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.).

attributes.name: security_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of implemented hardware security features (e.g., Secure Boot, TrustZone, AES-256, SHA-256, Hardware Root of Trust, Anti-Tamper).

attributes.name: spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this product specification (Draft: under development, Preliminary: pre-silicon or early silicon, Final: production-qualified, Obsolete: superseded by newer version).

attributes.name: transistor_architecture
attributes.description: Type of transistor structure used in the process technology (Planar, FinFET, GAA - Gate All Around, Nanosheet, Nanowire).

attributes.name: transistor_count
attributes.description: Total number of transistors in the integrated circuit design.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this product specification, following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each specification revision.

products.name: bom
products.description: Bill of Materials header records defining the hierarchical component structure of each IC product assembly. Captures BOM revision, effectivity dates, BOM type (engineering, manufacturing, service), approval status, and overall RoHS/REACH compliance rollup. Parent entity for bom_line detail records. Integrates with PLM and ERP systems for manufacturing execution and change management.
products.reference: BOM (Bill of Materials) — SAP PP / Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: bom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bill of materials header record. Primary key for the BOM entity.

attributes.name: primary_bom_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent IC product or assembly that this BOM defines. Links to the product master catalog.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: BOMs often designate a contract manufacturer or primary supplier for the overall assembly, needed for production planning.

attributes.name: to_ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: FK to product.ic_catalog.ic_catalog_id — Each BOM defines the component structure of a specific IC product. The BOM header must reference the product it describes.

attributes.name: alternative_bom_indicator
attributes.description: Identifier for alternative BOM configurations for the same product. Used when multiple valid component combinations exist (e.g., different suppliers, different process nodes, or design variants).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this BOM was formally approved for use. Marks the transition from draft/review to approved status.

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the parent product that this BOM defines. Typically 1 for single-unit BOMs, but may be higher for batch or lot-based manufacturing. All component quantities in BOM lines are relative to this base quantity.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the base quantity, such as EA (each), LOT, WAFER, or other semiconductor-specific units. Must align with product master UOM.

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the BOM, typically a human-readable code used across PLM and ERP systems for tracking and reference.

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the BOM. Draft indicates work in progress, in_review indicates pending approval, approved indicates ready for use, active indicates currently in production, frozen indicates locked for manufacturing, obsolete indicates no longer valid, superseded indicates replaced by newer revision. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|active|frozen|obsolete|superseded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use: engineering BOM (EBOM) for design, manufacturing BOM (MBOM) for production, service BOM for maintenance, planning BOM for forecasting, as-designed for original specification, or as-built for actual production configuration.

attributes.name: conflict_minerals_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the BOM and all its components are free from conflict minerals (tin, tantalum, tungsten, gold) sourced from conflict regions, per Dodd-Frank Act Section 1502 requirements.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total material cost. Typically USD for semiconductor industry but may vary by region.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: critical_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM contains components classified as critical materials (long lead time, single source, strategic importance). Used for supply chain risk management.

attributes.name: ear_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) or other EAR classification for this BOM. Determines export licensing requirements and restrictions.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this BOM revision is no longer valid for new production orders. Null indicates the BOM is currently active with no planned end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this BOM revision becomes valid and can be used for manufacturing, procurement, and costing. Critical for managing engineering changes and product transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP, Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: engineering_change_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the engineering change order that created or last modified this BOM revision. Critical for change traceability and audit compliance.
