attributes.name: freight_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total freight and logistics cost for this shipment in US dollars. Used for cost allocation, customer billing (if freight is charged), and supply chain cost analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Accounting; Incoterms 2020; SOX

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms including packaging. Required for carrier freight billing, customs declarations, and dangerous goods compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipment Weight; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the semiconductor products in this shipment. Required for customs declarations, import duties, and cross-border trade compliance.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization HS Nomenclature; BIS/EAR; ITAR

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between seller and buyer. Governs freight cost allocation and title transfer point. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality inspection certificate (Certificate of Conformance or Certificate of Analysis) accompanying the shipment. Required for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6.2; SAP S/4HANA QM Quality Certificate

attributes.name: is_multi_leg
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment involves multiple transportation legs (e.g., fab to OSAT to customer, or cross-border transshipment). Enables multi-leg shipment tracking and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipment Legs; IATA; BIS/EAR

attributes.name: lot_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of manufacturing lot numbers (wafer lot IDs) included in this shipment. Enables full traceability from customer delivery back to wafer fabrication and process engineering records in Camstar MES.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Tracking; SEMI E10; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.2 Traceability

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or customer-specific delivery requirements associated with this shipment (e.g., ESD handling, temperature-controlled transport).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Text; JEDEC JESD625 ESD Handling

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Total number of physical packages (boxes, reels, trays, tubes) included in this shipment. Used for carrier manifest, customs declaration, and receiving verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Handling Unit Management; JEDEC JESD22

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Physical packaging format used for the semiconductor products in this shipment. Determines handling requirements, ESD protection, and customer assembly line compatibility.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22; IPC-7711; SAP S/4HANA SD Packaging Material

attributes.name: pod_confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed as received by the customer at the delivery location per the proof of delivery (POD). Compared against shipped_quantity to identify shortages or overages.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Confirmation; ANSI X12 EDI 856

attributes.name: pod_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the customer confirmed receipt of the shipment as captured in the proof of delivery (POD). Triggers downstream invoice release and revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SOX

attributes.name: pod_signoff_reference
attributes.description: Customer signoff reference or electronic signature identifier from the proof of delivery document. Serves as legal evidence of delivery completion for dispute resolution and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Proof of Delivery; IFRS 15

attributes.name: quantity_shortage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer reported a quantity shortage at delivery (POD confirmed quantity less than shipped quantity). Triggers discrepancy investigation and potential credit memo.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Discrepancy; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7 Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contents comply with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; ECHA; IPC-1752A

attributes.name: receiving_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific customer receiving dock, warehouse, or facility where the shipment was delivered. Used for multi-site customer delivery routing and POD reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Ship-To Party; ANSI X12 EDI 856

attributes.name: rma_reference_number
attributes.description: Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number associated with this shipment if a return or dispute has been initiated. Links shipment to the RMA and reverse logistics process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns Order; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all semiconductor products in this shipment comply with the EU Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Directive. Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.
attributes.references: EU RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; IPC-1752A; JEDEC JESD97

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Carrier service tier selected for this shipment (e.g., overnight, express, standard ground). Determines transit time commitment and freight cost.

attributes.name: ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment physically departed the origin facility (fab, OSAT, or distribution center). Principal business event date for the shipment transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue Date; SEMI E10

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable shipment identifier used in carrier communications, customer EDI 856 ASN, and logistics documentation. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD outbound delivery number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Outbound Delivery; ANSI X12 EDI 856 ASN

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the shipment. Drives downstream processes including invoice release and revenue recognition upon delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Outbound Delivery Status; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers) physically shipped in this shipment. Expressed in the base unit of measure (UOM) for the product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Quantity; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity. EA = each (packaged IC), WFR = wafer, DIE = individual die, REEL = tape-and-reel, TRAY = JEDEC tray, TUBE = IC tube.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD22; SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the shipment record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Document; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: wrong_part_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer reported receipt of an incorrect part number or product. Triggers RMA process, root cause analysis, and corrective action in the quality management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Nonconformance; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7; IATF 16949

products.name: shipment_line
products.description: Line-level detail of a shipment record, linking specific order lines and quantities to a physical shipment. Captures shipped quantity, unit of measure, lot number, wafer lot ID, package type, serial numbers (where applicable), and inspection certificate references. Enables traceability from customer order line to physical shipment and supports RMA and quality dispute resolution.

attributes.name: shipment_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment line record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the shipment_line data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Item

attributes.name: allocation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.allocation_record. Business justification: Each shipment line in semiconductor fulfillment consumes a specific allocation record (wafer lot, die bank, or finished goods allocation). Adding shipment_line.allocation_record_id -> allocation_recor

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.delivery_schedule. Business justification: Each shipment line fulfills a specific delivery schedule line in the semiconductor order-to-cash process. Adding shipment_line.delivery_schedule_id -> delivery_schedule.delivery_schedule_id enables li

attributes.name: die_bank_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.die_bank. Business justification: shipment_line.die_bank_order_number is a plain-text denormalization of die_bank inventory. Shipping die bank (KGD) orders requires direct traceability from shipment line to die bank inventory record f

attributes.name: final_test_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to test.final_test_run. Business justification: Line-level CoC and test traceability: each shipment_line represents a specific lot/part number being shipped. Linking to the qualifying final_test_run is required for Certificate of Conformance genera

attributes.name: finished_good_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.finished_good. Business justification: Shipment line goods issue and certificate of conformance processes require linking each shipped line to the specific finished good inventory record. Lot traceability, REACH/RoHS compliance documentati

attributes.name: ic_design_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the Multi-Project Wafer run from which this shipment line's product originated. Enables traceability for MPW orders where multiple customer designs share a single wafer fabrication run.
attributes.references: Camstar MES - MPW Lot Management; SEMI Standards; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the wafer lot from which the shipped dies or packaged ICs originated. Enables fab-level traceability from customer shipment back to wafer fabrication run in the MES.
attributes.references: Camstar MES - Wafer Lot Tracking; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: primary_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment header record. Links this line to the physical shipment event (HEADER_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Outbound Delivery Header

attributes.name: primary_shipment_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer order line that this shipment line fulfills. Enables traceability from physical shipment back to the originating sales order line in the order-to-cash lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Sales Order Item

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, etc.) being shipped on this line. RESOURCE_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master; Oracle Agile PLM - Item Master

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.tapeout. Business justification: Shipment lines for ICs require tapeout traceability for certificate of conformance, customs export control documentation, and quality records. Tapeout identifies the specific GDS revision and mask set

attributes.name: to_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Critical fulfillment traceability link. Each shipment line fulfills a specific order line. Required for order fulfillment tracking, partial shipment management, and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: to_shipment_id
attributes.description: FK to order.shipment.shipment_id — Fundamental header-to-line relationship. Every shipment line must belong to exactly one shipment.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the product was physically handed over to the carrier or freight forwarder. Used for on-time shipment performance, revenue recognition trigger, and export documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Goods Issue Date; Incoterms 2020; SOX Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: advance_ship_notice_number
attributes.description: EDI Advance Ship Notice (ASN/856) document number transmitted to the customer prior to shipment. Enables customer receiving automation and inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - ASN; ANSI X12 856 Ship Notice/Manifest; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: backorder_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line represents a partial fulfillment of a backordered quantity, where the full ordered quantity could not be shipped due to inventory allocation constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Backorder Processing; JEDEC Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: certificate_of_conformance_number
attributes.description: Document number of the Certificate of Conformance issued by quality assurance, attesting that the shipped product meets all specified requirements. Required for automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace customers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949 Clause 8.6.2; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the semiconductor product was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, export control (EAR/ITAR), and RoHS/REACH compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; ITAR; RoHS Directive; REACH Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Record Creation; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5 Documented Information

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit selling price and line value (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Required for multi-currency order management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: Customer-assigned part number or device designation for the shipped product. Required for customer-facing shipping documents, ASN (Advance Ship Notice), and design-in traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Customer Material Number; Salesforce CRM Design-Win

attributes.name: date_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing date code in YYWW format (year + work week) indicating when the product was fabricated or assembled. Required for shelf-life management, FIFO inventory rotation, and customer quality audits.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD31 - Date Code; EIA-481 Tape and Reel Standards

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible SAP outbound delivery document number associated with this shipment line, used for customer communication and logistics coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Outbound Delivery (VL02N)

attributes.name: eccn_code
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number assigned to this product line item per the US Commerce Control List (CCL). Required for EAR compliance screening and export license determination for semiconductor products.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations - Commerce Control List; CHIPS Act Compliance

attributes.name: goods_issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when goods issue was posted in SAP, marking the transfer of ownership and triggering revenue recognition and inventory reduction. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this transaction line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module - Goods Issue Posting; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: inspection_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the quality inspection certificate (Certificate of Conformance or Certificate of Analysis) issued for this shipment line. Links to quality records from KLA ICOS inspection systems and QM module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Quality Certificate; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line item is subject to ITAR controls as a defense article or defense service. When true, requires State Department export license and end-use certificate.
attributes.references: ITAR - International Traffic in Arms Regulations; 22 CFR Parts 120-130

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled Flag

attributes.name: line_net_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this shipment line (shipped_quantity × unit_selling_price after applicable discounts). Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and SOX financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Value; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the parent shipment, used to order and reference individual line items. LINE_SEQUENCE per TRANSACTION_LINE role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Item Number

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle status of this shipment line. Tracks progression from open through picking, packing, shipment, and delivery confirmation or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Item Status; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturing lot number assigned during wafer fabrication or assembly. Critical for traceability, quality dispute resolution, and RMA processing. Sourced from Camstar MES lot management.
attributes.references: Camstar MES - Lot Management; JEDEC JESD31; ISO 9001 Traceability

attributes.name: moisture_sensitivity_level
attributes.description: JEDEC moisture sensitivity level classification for the shipped packaged IC. Determines floor life, storage, and baking requirements at the customer's SMT assembly facility.
attributes.references: JEDEC J-STD-020 Moisture Sensitivity Classification; JEDEC J-STD-033

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity requested on the customer order line for this product. Enables calculation of fulfillment rate and identification of short-ships or over-ships.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Order Quantity

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Semiconductor package type for the shipped product (e.g., BGA, QFN, WLCSP, InFO, CoWoS, TSOP, DIP, SOP). Determines handling, inspection, and customer board assembly requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BGA|QFN|WLCSP|InFO|CoWoS|TSOP|DIP|SOP|LGA|CSP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD30 - Package Type Designations; IPC Standards

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Physical packaging configuration used for the shipped semiconductor units. Determines handling requirements, moisture sensitivity level (MSL), and customer SMT assembly compatibility.
attributes.references: EIA-481 Tape and Reel Standards; JEDEC J-STD-033 Moisture Sensitivity; IPC Standards

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer part number (MPN) for the shipped semiconductor product as listed in the product catalog and on the shipping documentation. Used for customer identification and BOM matching.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Item Master; JEDEC JESD31; IPC-2578

attributes.name: partial_shipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line represents a partial shipment against the order line quantity. When true, additional shipment lines are expected to fulfill the remaining ordered quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Partial Delivery; Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Committed delivery date for this shipment line as agreed with the customer at order entry. Used for on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement and customer SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Confirmed Delivery Date; JEDEC Supply Chain

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped product complies with EU REACH regulation requirements for chemical substance registration and restriction. Required for EU market access and supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation EC 1907/2006; IPC-1752A Material Declaration

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Hardware or mask revision level of the shipped IC (e.g., A0, B1, C2). Critical for customer compatibility verification, PCN (Product Change Notification) compliance, and field failure analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Product Revision; JEDEC JESD46 PCN; IPC-2578

attributes.name: rma_reference_number
attributes.description: RMA number associated with this shipment line if it is a replacement shipment for a previously returned or disputed lot. Enables linkage between original shipment, quality dispute, and replacement fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Returns Processing; Oracle Agile PLM - Quality Dispute; ISO 9001 Clause 8.7

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipped product complies with EU RoHS Directive restrictions on hazardous substances (lead, mercury, cadmium, etc.). Required for EU market access and customer compliance declarations.

tag_set.value: Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) Compliant Flag

attributes.name: serial_number_range_end
attributes.description: Ending serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Used with serial_number_range_start to define the complete set of serialized units shipped.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Serial Number Management; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: serial_number_range_start
attributes.description: Starting serial number of the serialized unit range included in this shipment line. Applicable for high-value or security-sensitive ICs requiring individual unit traceability (e.g., automotive, military-grade).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Serial Number Management; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of semiconductor units (dies, packaged ICs, wafers, etc.) physically shipped on this line. LINE_QUANTITY per TRANSACTION_LINE role. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial shipments or allocation constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Actual Quantity Delivered; JEDEC JESD31

attributes.name: temperature_grade
attributes.description: Operating temperature range grade of the shipped IC (commercial: 0–70°C, industrial: -40–85°C, automotive: -40–125°C, military: -55–125°C). Critical for customer application qualification and IATF 16949 automotive compliance.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47; IATF 16949; AEC-Q100 Automotive IC Qualification

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the shipped quantity. Common semiconductor UoMs include EA (each/die), WFR (wafer), LOT (production lot), REEL (tape-and-reel packaging), TRAY (IC tray), BOX (carton). Aligned with SAP base UoM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Unit of Measure; JEDEC JESD31; SEMI Standards

attributes.name: unit_selling_price
attributes.description: Agreed selling price per unit for this shipment line as invoiced to the customer. LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT per TRANSACTION_LINE role. Sensitive commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Price; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this shipment line record. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and Silver Layer delta processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Change Document; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wafer_start_authorization_number
attributes.description: Wafer Start Authorization number that triggered the production lot associated with this shipment line. Links shipment fulfillment back to the original fab capacity commitment in the order-to-cash lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Production Order; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: yield_grade
attributes.description: Quality or speed grade assigned to the shipped product based on wafer test (probe) results and final test binning. Indicates performance tier (e.g., commercial, industrial, automotive, military grade) for the shipped units.
attributes.references: JEDEC JESD47 - Stress-Test-Driven Qualification; IATF 16949; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

products.name: backlog_position
products.description: Point-in-time snapshot of open order backlog for a specific order line, capturing unshipped committed quantity, backlog value, original promise date, current commit date, and backlog aging in days. Used for backlog management, revenue forecasting, customer escalation prioritization, and quarterly book-to-bill ratio reporting. Tracks push-outs, pull-ins, and cancellations affecting committed backlog. Critical for semiconductor revenue recognition, quarterly close processes, and investor guidance on backlog coverage.

attributes.name: backlog_position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each backlog position snapshot record in the order-to-cash lifecycle. Primary key for the backlog_position data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this backlog position. Used for customer-level backlog aggregation, escalation prioritization, and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: allocation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to order.allocation_record. Business justification: Backlog positions track allocation_status (STRING) as a denormalized field. Adding backlog_position.allocation_record_id -> allocation_record.allocation_record_id links each backlog snapshot to the au

attributes.name: design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Semiconductor backlog management distinguishes design-win-driven demand from spot orders. Linking backlog positions to the originating design win (beyond the boolean design_win_flag) enables design-wi

attributes.name: fabrication_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.fabrication_wafer_lot. Business justification: Semiconductor order management tracks backlog positions against specific WIP wafer lots for real-time commit accuracy. backlog_position.wafer_lot_number is a denormalized reference to fabrication_wafe

attributes.name: family_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.family. Business justification: Semiconductor backlog management and fab capacity planning are performed at the product family level. Family-level backlog aggregation (by business unit, process node, lifecycle status) is a standard

attributes.name: finished_good_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.finished_good. Business justification: Semiconductor backlog management reports match open demand (backlog positions) against finished good inventory to determine fulfillment feasibility and commit dates. part_number is a plain-text denorm

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent sales order header to which this backlog position belongs. Links the backlog snapshot to the originating customer order.

attributes.name: price_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.price_agreement. Business justification: Semiconductor backlog valuation and revenue recognition reporting require knowing which price agreement governs each backlog position (net_selling_price, backlog_value). Price agreements define locked

attributes.name: primary_order_line_id
attributes.description: FK to order.order_line.order_line_id — Backlog positions track unshipped quantities for specific order lines. Without this FK, backlog cannot be reconciled to orders.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semiconductor product (IC, SoC, ASIC, FPGA, or discrete device) associated with this backlog position. Enables product-level backlog analysis and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: stock_balance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_balance. Business justification: Available-to-promise (ATP) and backlog coverage reports in semiconductor operations directly join backlog positions to stock balance records to compute uncommitted inventory. This is a named operation

attributes.name: allocated_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity from available inventory or in-process production lots that has been formally allocated to fulfill this backlog position. May be less than committed_quantity in constrained supply scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; Camstar MES

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Indicates the degree to which available inventory or production capacity has been allocated to fulfill this backlog position. Critical for backlog management and supply-demand balancing in constrained semiconductor supply environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: backlog_aging_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this order line has been in open backlog as of the snapshot date, calculated from order_entry_date. Used for customer escalation prioritization and aged backlog reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: backlog_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of this backlog position. 'open' = unshipped committed order; 'committed' = confirmed with delivery date; 'at_risk' = delivery commitment in jeopardy; 'pushed_out' = delivery date deferred; 'cancelled' = order line cancelled; 'fulfilled' = shipped and closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: backlog_value
attributes.description: The monetary value of the unshipped committed backlog quantity, calculated as committed_quantity multiplied by the net selling price. Used for revenue forecasting, quarterly guidance, and book-to-bill ratio reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Module; SOX Financial Reporting; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: cancelled_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity cancelled from the original order line. Tracks cancellation impact on backlog coverage and book-to-bill ratio reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: committed_quantity
attributes.description: The unshipped quantity (in units) that remains committed in backlog for this order line as of the snapshot date. Core metric for backlog management and production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this backlog position record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the backlog value and selling price are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, KRW, TWD). Required for multi-currency backlog reporting and FX exposure analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: current_commit_date
attributes.description: The most recent confirmed delivery date committed to the customer, reflecting any push-outs or pull-ins from the original promise date. Used for revenue forecasting and quarterly close planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: customer_part_number
attributes.description: The customer's own part number or reference code for the ordered product. Required for customer-facing order confirmations and cross-referencing customer purchase orders with internal part numbers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_po_number
attributes.description: The customer's purchase order number referencing this backlog position. Required for customer reconciliation, invoice matching, and accounts receivable processing.

attributes.name: design_win_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog position is associated with a strategic design-win account tracked in Salesforce CRM. Design-win orders receive elevated fulfillment priority to protect long-term revenue relationships.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; JEDEC Customer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: end_market_segment
attributes.description: The end-market application segment for which the ordered semiconductor product is destined. Used for segment-level backlog analysis, demand forecasting, and investor guidance on market exposure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: computing|mobile|automotive|industrial|iot|communications|consumer|ai_datacenter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Market Segmentation

attributes.name: export_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is subject to export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). When true, shipment requires validated export license or license exception before fulfillment.

attributes.name: export_license_number

attributes.name: hold_code

Examples include credit hold, export license pending, quality hold, or customer-requested hold. Null when no hold is active. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_hold|export_hold|quality_hold|customer_hold|compliance_hold|capacity_hold — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between seller and buyer for this order line. Impacts revenue recognition timing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this backlog position record was most recently modified, reflecting the latest change to any field such as commit date revision, quantity adjustment, or status change.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: net_selling_price
attributes.description: The agreed net unit selling price for this order line after all applicable discounts and price adjustments. Used to compute backlog value and support revenue recognition under ASC 606.

attributes.name: order_entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer order was originally entered into the order management system. Used to calculate backlog aging and time-in-backlog metrics.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the order type driving this backlog position. Distinguishes standard production orders from Multi-Project Wafer (MPW) orders, die bank orders, wafer start authorizations, sample orders, Return Material Authorizations (RMA), and consignment orders. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|mpw|die_bank|wafer_start|sample|rma|consignment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: original_order_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity originally ordered by the customer on this order line. Used to calculate fulfillment percentage and track cancellation or reduction impacts on backlog.

attributes.name: original_promise_date
attributes.description: The initial delivery date committed to the customer at the time of order entry. Baseline for measuring push-outs and delivery performance against original commitment.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned to this backlog position for allocation and fulfillment sequencing. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used during supply-constrained periods to prioritize strategic customers and design-win accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: push_out_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the current_commit_date has been deferred beyond the original_promise_date. Positive value indicates a push-out (delay); negative value indicates a pull-in (acceleration). Key metric for delivery performance and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Order Management Standards

attributes.name: push_out_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the delivery commitment was pushed out or pulled in. Examples include wafer yield issue, capacity constraint, material shortage, customer request, or logistics delay. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: yield_issue|capacity_constraint|material_shortage|customer_request|logistics_delay|design_change|export_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; JEDEC Standards

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date originally requested by the customer on the purchase order. May differ from the original promise date if the committed date was negotiated.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backlog position meets the criteria for revenue recognition upon shipment under ASC 606 / IFRS 15. False indicates revenue deferral conditions apply (e.g., consignment, bill-and-hold arrangements).
attributes.references: ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region associated with this backlog position (e.g., Americas, EMEA, Japan, Greater China, Rest of APAC). Used for regional backlog reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for shipment. Used for export control screening, logistics routing, and regional revenue reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; BIS/EAR Export Administration Regulations; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity already shipped against this order line as of the snapshot date. Together with committed_quantity, reconciles to the original order quantity.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this point-in-time backlog position snapshot was captured. Enables time-series backlog trending, quarterly close reporting, and book-to-bill ratio calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which quantities are expressed for this backlog position. EA = each (individual units), KU = thousands of units, WAFER = full wafer, DIE = individual die, REEL = tape-and-reel packaging unit, TRAY = tray packaging unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; JEDEC Standards

products.name: allocation_record
products.description: Inventory, capacity, and lot allocation record that reserves specific wafer lots, die bank inventory, finished goods, or fab capacity against a customer order line. SSOT for all allocation and lot-to-order assignment decisions in the order fulfillment process. Manages constrained supply allocation across competing customer orders during supply shortages. Supports automotive (IATF 16949) and aerospace lot-level traceability requirements from order through shipment.

attributes.description: The actual date on which the allocated goods were shipped to the customer. Used for on-time delivery measurement and order fulfillment confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.description: The quantity of units (dies, wafers, or packaged devices) reserved against the customer order line. Expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the lot type.

domains.name: quality
domains.description: Quality assurance, reliability testing, defect inspection, metrology, DPPM tracking, FMEA, and qualification programs. products.name: inspection_lot
products.description: Master record for a quality inspection lot representing a batch of wafers, dies, or packaged units submitted for quality inspection at any stage. Captures lot origin, supplier ID (for IQC), inspection type, inspection stage, lot size, sampling plan parameters (AQL, sample size, acceptance/rejection numbers), inspection results, measured parameters, and disposition decision (accept, reject, hold, rework). Integrates with SAP QM and Camstar MES for lot status management and goods receipt inspection. SSOT for all quality inspection activities across the fab-to-finish flow including incoming quality control.

products.name: defect_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing individual defect events, wafer-level defect maps, and spatial bin distributions detected during wafer inspection, die sort, or final test. At the defect event level: stores defect classification code, defect coordinates (X/Y on wafer map), defect size, defect layer (FEOL/MOL/BEOL), detection method (KLA ICOS optical, e-beam, SEM), severity rating, and disposition (scrap, rework, accept). At the wafer map level: captures per-wafer die grid coordinates, per-die pass/fail bin assignment, defect density per zone, edge exclusion zone, flat/notch orientation, and map generation timestamp. Enables yield spatial analysis, systematic defect pattern detection (repeater analysis, cluster detection), and wafer-level bin map visualization. Integrates directly with KLA ICOS inspection system output and ATE wafer probing systems. SSOT for all defect events, spatial defect analysis, and wafer-level quality maps.

products.name: reliability_test
products.description: Master record for reliability qualification programs and individual test execution, encompassing program definition, test planning, stress test execution, and failure event tracking. At the program level: captures qualification type (new product, process change, OSAT qualification, PCN-driven), applicable standards (AEC-Q100, JEDEC JESD47, ISO 9001), qualification plan version, milestone schedule, overall qualification status, and approval authority. At the test level: captures test type (HTOL, HAST, TC, ESD, JEDEC stress tests), test conditions (temperature, voltage, humidity, duration), sample size, device type, pass/fail criteria, and individual failure details including failed unit serial number, failure time (hours), failure mode, failure analysis method (SEM, FIB, EMMI, curve trace), root cause classification, and failure mechanism (electromigration, TDDB, HCI, NBTI). SSOT for JEDEC JESD47 and AEC-Q100/Q101 qualification lifecycle from program initiation through test execution to final disposition, FIT rate calculations, and Weibull reliability modeling.

products.name: nonconformance_report
products.description: Non-Conformance Report (NCR) and quality hold management record documenting product or process deviations from specification, managing lot hold/release lifecycle, and tracking material review board dispositions. Captures NCR number, affected lot/wafer/unit range, non-conformance description, specification violated, detection point, hold type (process excursion, SPC out-of-control, customer complaint, reliability failure), hold initiation and release timestamps, hold reason, hold release conditions with approver, disposition decision (use-as-is, rework, scrap, return to supplier), material review board (MRB) decision, responsible quality engineer, required disposition actions, and financial impact assessment. SSOT for all in-process quality escapes, quality holds, MRB dispositions, and lot release management. Integrates with Camstar MES and SAP QM for lot status management.

products.description: Transactional record capturing individual unit-level test results from all test insertions including wafer probing, die sort, final test, and system-level test (SLT). Records unit identifier (X/Y die coordinates for wafer-level or device serial/unit position for package-level), test insertion stage discriminator, assigned hard-bin and soft-bin codes per bin_definition, pass/fail status, total test time, parametric measurement summary flags, retest indicator and retest count, KGD (Known Good Die) qualification status, multi-die/chiplet assembly position, and test temperature/voltage condition. Serves as the single source of truth for all unit-level test outcomes across the entire test flow, enabling wafer map generation, unit-level yield analysis, full lot traceability, and die-to-package correlation. Aligns with STDF PTR/FTR/MPR record concepts.

attributes.name: part_volume_cm3
attributes.description: Physical volume of a single unit of the part in cubic centimeters.

attributes.name: part_weight_kg
attributes.description: Physical weight of a single unit of the part in kilograms.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory quantity threshold that triggers a replenishment order.

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Buffer quantity kept to protect against demand variability and supply delays.

attributes.name: spare_part_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the part within the inventory system.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Environmental condition required for safe storage of the part.

attributes.name: supplier
attributes.description: Primary external supplier or vendor from which the part is sourced.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard purchase cost per individual unit of the part.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who last modified the record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the spare part record.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer's warranty for the part expires.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who created the record.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Inventory management for WIP wafer lots, raw materials (silicon wafers, chemicals, gases, photomasks), finished goods (packaged chips), die banks, and consignment stock at OSAT partners. Tracks lot traceability, KGD status, bin classifications, shelf life, storage conditions, and inventory valuation.

products.name: inventory_wafer_lot
products.description: Master record for a wafer lot (batch of wafers) moving through the FAB as work-in-process inventory. Tracks lot ID, wafer count, process node, product code, lot type (production/engineering/qualification), priority class, current operation step, WIP status (active/hold/complete/scrapped), start date, target completion date, hold flags, cumulative scrap count, good wafer count, and MES lot reference. SSOT for WIP lot identity and traceability across FEOL, MOL, and BEOL process stages within the inventory domain.
products.reference: Camstar MES Lot Master / SAP PP WIP Lot

attributes.name: inventory_wafer_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the wafer lot master record within the inventory domain. Primary key for the inventory_wafer_lot data product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — this entity represents a discrete WIP business event (a lot moving through FAB) with a clear lifecycle, party references, timestamps, and quantitative results.
attributes.references: Camstar MES Lot Management; SEMI E10

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this wafer lot is being fabricated. Applicable for foundry/OSAT business models where lots are customer-specific. Null for internal product lots. This is the PARTY_REFERENCE category field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: design_win_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_design_win. Business justification: Required for Production Tracking Report linking each wafer lot to the originating customer design win for revenue and yield attribution.

attributes.name: fab_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fabrication.fab_run_card. Business justification: Enables Run Card Traceability report connecting inventory wafer lot to the fab run card that produced it.

attributes.name: fab_tool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment unit currently processing or last processing this wafer lot. Enables equipment-to-lot traceability for defect root cause analysis and equipment qualification tracking.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: flow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to process.process_flow. Business justification: Inventory WIP tracking requires knowing which process.process_flow a wafer lot is routed through for scheduling, cycle time monitoring, and yield forecasting. The existing fabrication_process_flow_id

attributes.name: ic_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.ic_catalog. Business justification: Required for Wafer Lot Production Traceability Report linking each wafer lot to its IC catalog; replaces denormalized product_code with a proper FK.

attributes.name: inbound_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_shipment. Business justification: Purchased wafer lots (bare silicon wafers from suppliers) arrive via inbound shipments. Linking inventory_wafer_lot to inbound_shipment enables shipment-to-WIP traceability for incoming wafer quality

attributes.name: pdk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to design.pdk. Business justification: WIP wafer lots must be traceable to the PDK version used in fabrication for process change management, yield analysis by PDK revision, and regulatory export control. Fab MES and inventory systems in s

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SD sales order that triggered this wafer lot start. Links WIP inventory to customer demand for order-to-cash traceability and delivery commitment tracking.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: inventory_wafer_lot has a denormalized storage_location_code (STRING) but no FK to the storage_location master. WIP wafer lots are physically stored in specific cleanroom bays and staging areas tracke

attributes.name: tapeout_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tapeout record (final design submission for manufacturing) associated with this wafer lot. Links WIP inventory to the design domain for design-to-silicon traceability and first silicon yield analysis.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; Oracle Agile PLM; design.tapeout

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the wafer lot completed all FAB process steps. Populated upon lot completion. Used for cycle time actuals, on-time delivery KPI calculation, and process improvement analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer lot master record was first created in the inventory data product (Silver layer). Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: current_operation_step
attributes.description: The current process operation step name or code at which the wafer lot is positioned in the process flow (e.g., 'FEOL_Gate_Oxide', 'MOL_Contact_Etch', 'BEOL_Metal1_CVD'). Sourced from the MES process flow definition. Critical for WIP traceability and cycle time analysis.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: die_per_wafer
attributes.description: Theoretical number of die that can be patterned on a single wafer for this product at the given process node and die size. Used as the denominator for yield calculations and finished goods quantity forecasting.
attributes.references: SEMI; Camstar MES; KLA ICOS Inspection Systems

attributes.name: good_wafer_count
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot that have passed all in-line inspection and metrology checks to date. Represents the current count of wafers expected to yield good die. Updated after each inspection or disposition event.
attributes.references: KLA ICOS Inspection Systems; Camstar MES; SEMI E10

attributes.name: hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the wafer lot is currently placed on hold and cannot proceed to the next process step. A True value means the lot is blocked pending engineering review, quality disposition, or management approval. Sourced from MES hold management.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; ISO 9001

attributes.name: hold_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for the current or most recent hold placed on the wafer lot (e.g., 'PROCESS_EXCURSION', 'EQUIPMENT_FAILURE', 'YIELD_LOSS', 'CUSTOMER_REQUEST', 'ENGINEERING_REVIEW'). Populated when hold_flag is True. Used for hold disposition tracking and FMEA analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PROCESS_EXCURSION|EQUIPMENT_FAILURE|YIELD_LOSS|CUSTOMER_REQUEST|ENGINEERING_REVIEW|MATERIAL_SHORTAGE|QUALITY_DISPOSITION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA QM; SEMI E10; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: hold_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the most recent hold was placed on the wafer lot. Null if the lot has never been placed on hold. Used for hold duration tracking and SPC (Statistical Process Control) excursion response time measurement.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA QM; SEMI E10

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Current standard cost valuation of the wafer lot in the inventory ledger, expressed in the functional currency. Calculated based on the number of wafers and the standard cost per wafer at the current process step. Used for WIP inventory valuation in SAP FI/CO and financial reporting under SOX.

attributes.name: lithography_type
attributes.description: Type of photolithography exposure technology used for the critical layers of this wafer lot. EUV (Extreme Ultraviolet) is used for leading-edge nodes (sub-7nm); DUV (Deep Ultraviolet) for mature nodes. Determines equipment routing and cost structure.
attributes.references: SEMI; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; IEEE

attributes.name: lot_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the wafer lot was officially started (wafer start authorization executed) in the FAB. Used for cycle time measurement, WIP aging analysis, and on-time delivery tracking. This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) category field.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; SEMI E10

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the wafer lot within the FAB WIP flow. 'active' indicates the lot is progressing through process steps; 'on_hold' indicates a hold flag is set pending disposition; 'completed' indicates all process steps are finished; 'scrapped' indicates the lot has been disposed; 'cancelled' indicates the lot was terminated before completion. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category field.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA PP; SEMI E10

attributes.name: lot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the wafer lot by its manufacturing purpose. 'production' lots are for customer shipment; 'engineering' lots support process development; 'qualification' lots validate new processes or products; 'monitor' lots track process stability; 'reliability' lots support JEDEC/IATF reliability testing. This is the CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category field.

attributes.name: mes_lot_reference
attributes.description: Native lot reference number as recorded in the Applied Materials SmartFactory or Camstar MES system. Enables direct cross-reference to the operational system of record for lot tracking, dispatch, and WIP management.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES

attributes.name: priority_class
attributes.description: Dispatch priority classification assigned to the wafer lot, used by MES to sequence lot movement through FAB equipment queues. 'hot' lots receive highest priority for customer-critical or yield-recovery situations; 'expedite' for accelerated delivery; 'standard' for normal flow; 'low' for non-urgent engineering runs.
attributes.references: Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; Camstar MES; SEMI E3

attributes.name: process_node
attributes.description: Semiconductor manufacturing process technology node (e.g., 5nm, 7nm, 14nm, 28nm, 65nm) used to fabricate this wafer lot. Determines the Process Design Kit (PDK), equipment set, and yield expectations. Critical for capacity planning and technology roadmap tracking.

attributes.name: process_stage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Process Stage (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)
attributes.description: High-level semiconductor fabrication stage classification: FEOL (Front End of Line) covers transistor formation; MOL (Middle of Line) covers local interconnects; BEOL (Back End of Line) covers metal interconnect layers. Used for WIP stage-gate reporting and cycle time decomposition.
attributes.references: SEMI; IEEE; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

tag_set.value: Process Stage (Front End of Line / Middle of Line / Back End of Line)

attributes.name: scrap_wafer_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of wafers scrapped from this lot since lot creation. Includes wafers scrapped due to process excursions, equipment failures, or quality dispositions. Used for yield loss analysis and DPPM (Defective Parts Per Million) reporting.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SAP S/4HANA QM; SEMI E10; ISO 9001

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this wafer lot record was sourced (e.g., CAMSTAR for Camstar MES, SMARTFACTORY for Applied Materials SmartFactory, SAP_PP for SAP Production Planning). Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which the wafer lot is expected to complete all FAB process steps and be ready for wafer probe/test. Derived from the process flow cycle time and lot start date. Used for delivery commitment and capacity planning.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this wafer lot master record was last modified in the inventory data product. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail.

attributes.name: valuation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the inventory valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: wafer_count_current
attributes.description: Current number of wafers remaining in the lot after accounting for any scrapped or split wafers during processing. Reflects real-time WIP inventory quantity for this lot.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; Applied Materials SmartFactory MES

attributes.name: wafer_count_start
attributes.description: Number of wafers in the lot at the time of lot creation (wafer start). Typically 25 wafers per FOUP/cassette for standard lots. Used as the baseline denominator for yield and scrap rate calculations. This is the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT / principal measured quantity for this WIP transaction.
attributes.references: Camstar MES; SEMI E47; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: wafer_diameter_mm
attributes.description: Physical diameter of the silicon wafers in this lot, in millimeters. Standard values are 200mm (8-inch) and 300mm (12-inch). Determines equipment compatibility, cassette type, and cost per wafer.

products.name: raw_material
products.description: Master record for raw materials consumed in semiconductor manufacturing including silicon wafers (bare and epitaxial), process chemicals, specialty gases, photomasks, CMP slurries, and ALD precursors. Captures material code, description, material class, unit of measure, supplier part number, shelf life, storage temperature range, hazard classification (RoHS/REACH), reorder point, and safety stock level. SSOT for raw material identity in the inventory domain.

attributes.name: raw_material_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a raw material master record in the semiconductor inventory domain. Primary key for the raw_material product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master (MARA)

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: raw_material (inventory-side) and material_master (supply-side) represent the same physical material from different operational perspectives. This FK is the standard ERP integration between inventory

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: FK to inventory.storage_location.storage_location_id — Raw materials need a default storage location for receiving and replenishment workflows.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier. Business justification: PROCUREMENT: Supplier of each raw material is required for qualification, lead‑time, and compliance tracking; experts expect a direct supplier_id FK.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure in which the raw material is stocked and consumed (e.g., EA for each wafer, KG for chemicals, L for liquids, M2 for photomasks). Corresponds to SAP MARA.MEINS (base unit of measure). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M2|M3|PC|SHT|BOX|DRUM|CYLINDER — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MEINS; ISO 80000; SEMI E10

attributes.name: batch_managed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is managed at the batch/lot level in SAP inventory management. Batch management is mandatory for silicon wafers, photomasks, and shelf-life-controlled chemicals to enable full lot traceability from receipt through consumption. Corresponds to SAP MARA.XCHPF.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.XCHPF; SEMI E142 (Lot Traceability); ISO 9001

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: The unique CAS Registry Number assigned by the American Chemical Society to identify chemical substances. Mandatory for process chemicals, specialty gases, CMP slurries, and ALD precursors for REACH, RoHS, and TSCA regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU; TSCA; CAS Registry

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the raw material was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for export control compliance (EAR/ITAR), customs declarations, and CHIPS Act domestic content tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; BIS/EAR (Export Administration Regulations); ITAR; CHIPS Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the raw material master record was first created in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA MM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with SOX internal controls over financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.ERSDA / MARA.ERNAM; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the raw material is scheduled to be discontinued or reaches end-of-life (EOL). Triggers last-time-buy (LTB) procurement actions and product change notification (PCN) processes. Null if the material is not scheduled for discontinuation.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - PCN/EOL Management; SAP S/4HANA MM; JEDEC JESD48

attributes.name: export_control_classification
attributes.description: Export Control Classification Number (ECCN) assigned under the US Export Administration Regulations (EAR) for dual-use materials. Required for export license determination for specialty chemicals, gases, and advanced materials used in semiconductor manufacturing.
attributes.references: BIS/EAR - Commerce Control List (CCL); EAR Part 774; ITAR

attributes.name: fixed_lot_qty
attributes.description: Fixed order quantity used when lot_size_type is 'fixed'. Represents the standard purchase order quantity per replenishment cycle, often aligned with supplier minimum order quantities or packaging units. Corresponds to SAP MARC.BSTFE.

attributes.name: hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS/UN hazard classification of the raw material for safe storage, handling, and transport. Drives storage location assignment, PPE requirements, and emergency response procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_hazardous|flammable|corrosive|toxic|oxidizer|pyrophoric|compressed_gas|carcinogen — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; ISO 45001

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming quality inspection (IQC) is mandatory upon goods receipt for this raw material. When true, received lots are placed in quality inspection stock in SAP QM before being released to unrestricted use. Corresponds to SAP MARC.QKZUL.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - MARC.QKZUL; ISO 9001 Clause 8.6; IATF 16949

attributes.name: itar_controlled
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material is subject to ITAR controls under the US Munitions List. ITAR-controlled materials require State Department licensing for export and impose strict access and handling restrictions.
attributes.references: ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130); US Munitions List (USML)

tag_set.value: International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) Controlled

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the raw material master record. Supports change tracking, delta extraction for the Silver layer, and audit compliance. Corresponds to SAP MARA.LAEDA (last change date).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.LAEDA; SOX Section 404; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Planned procurement lead time in calendar days from purchase order placement to goods receipt. Used by SAP MRP for replenishment scheduling and safety stock calculations. Corresponds to SAP MARC.PLIFZ (planned delivery time).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP - MARC.PLIFZ; SEMI E10

attributes.name: lot_size_type
attributes.description: SAP MRP lot-sizing procedure that determines how replenishment quantities are calculated. 'fixed' orders a fixed quantity, 'lot_for_lot' orders exact requirement, 'min_max' uses min/max boundaries, 'periodic' groups requirements by period. Corresponds to SAP MARC.DISMM.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The original manufacturer's part number for the raw material, which may differ from the supplier part number when the supplier is a distributor. Critical for photomasks, specialty chemicals, and ALD precursors where manufacturer identity affects process qualification.
attributes.references: Oracle Agile PLM - Manufacturer Part; JEDEC

attributes.name: material_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the raw material type used in semiconductor manufacturing. Drives storage, handling, and compliance rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: silicon_wafer|photomask|process_chemical|specialty_gas|cmp_slurry|ald_precursor|packaging_material|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Type (MTART); SEMI E10; JEDEC

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the raw material in SAP S/4HANA MM (Material Master number / MATNR). Used across procurement, inventory, and manufacturing systems as the primary business identifier for the material.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MATNR; SEMI E10

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: SAP material group code (MARA.MATKL) used to categorize raw materials for procurement, reporting, and spend analytics. Examples: 'WAFER-SI', 'CHEM-ETCH', 'GAS-SPEC', 'MASK-EUV'.

attributes.name: material_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short description or name of the raw material (e.g., 'Silicon Wafer 300mm P-Type', 'HMDS Adhesion Promoter', 'ArF Photomask Layer 1'). Corresponds to SAP MARA.MAKTX (material description).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MAKTX; Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: material_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the raw material master record. Controls whether the material can be procured, consumed in production, or is subject to end-of-life (EOL) restrictions. Aligns with SAP MARA.MMSTA (plant-level material status).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MMSTA; Oracle Agile PLM PCN process

attributes.name: max_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum allowable inventory quantity for the raw material, used to prevent overstocking of hazardous materials, shelf-life-limited chemicals, or high-cost items. Corresponds to SAP MARC.MABST (maximum stock level).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP - MARC.MABST; ISO 14001 (hazardous material quantity limits)

attributes.name: min_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at the time of goods receipt for the material to be accepted into inventory. Materials received with less than this remaining shelf life are rejected or placed in restricted use. Corresponds to SAP MARA.MHDLP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MHDLP; ISO 9001; IATF 16949

attributes.name: moving_avg_price
attributes.description: Current moving average price per base unit of measure, recalculated with each goods receipt based on actual purchase prices. Used for inventory valuation under the moving average price control method. Corresponds to SAP MBEW.VERPR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - MBEW.VERPR; IFRS IAS 2; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: price_control_type
attributes.description: Determines the inventory valuation method for the material: 'standard' uses a fixed standard price, 'moving_average' recalculates price with each goods movement. Corresponds to SAP MBEW.VPRSV (price control indicator: S or V).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - MBEW.VPRSV; IFRS IAS 2; SOX

attributes.name: price_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard price and moving average price fields (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, TWD). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI - MBEW.WAERS; SOX

attributes.name: purity_pct
attributes.description: Chemical purity of the raw material expressed as a percentage (e.g., 99.9999 for 6N-grade specialty gases, 99.99 for ultra-high-purity chemicals). Critical quality specification for process chemicals, specialty gases, and ALD precursors where trace contamination causes yield loss.
attributes.references: SEMI C1 (Ultra-High Purity Chemicals); SEMI C7.4; ISO 9001

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Process qualification status of the raw material indicating whether it has been approved for use in production. Materials must pass incoming quality inspection and process qualification before being released for fab consumption. Managed in Oracle Agile PLM and SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM; Oracle Agile PLM; ISO 9001 Clause 8.4; IATF 16949

attributes.name: reach_svhc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material contains or is classified as a Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) under the EU REACH Regulation. Triggers mandatory disclosure obligations when SVHC concentration exceeds 0.1% w/w in articles.
attributes.references: REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 Article 57; ECHA SVHC Candidate List

tag_set.value: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Substance of Very High Concern (SVHC) Flag

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Inventory level at which a replenishment purchase requisition is automatically triggered in SAP MRP. When on-hand stock falls to or below this quantity, procurement is initiated to prevent production line stoppages. Corresponds to SAP MARC.MINBE (reorder point).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP - MARC.MINBE; SEMI E10

attributes.name: resistivity_ohm_cm
attributes.description: Electrical resistivity of the silicon wafer substrate in Ohm·cm, indicating doping concentration and conductivity type. Critical specification for FEOL process compatibility and device electrical performance. Null for non-wafer materials.
attributes.references: SEMI M1; SEMI M6 (Resistivity Measurement); JEDEC JESD22

attributes.name: rohs_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the raw material complies with the EU RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU) restricting the use of hazardous substances including lead, mercury, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, PBB, and PBDE. Required for materials used in products shipped to EU markets.

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against supply disruptions, demand variability, and supplier lead time uncertainty. Represents the floor below which inventory should not fall under normal operating conditions. Corresponds to SAP MARC.EISBE (safety stock).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/MRP - MARC.EISBE; SEMI E10

attributes.name: serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of the raw material are tracked by unique serial number. Applicable to high-value items such as photomasks and reticles where individual unit traceability is required for defect root cause analysis and reticle qualification tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Serial Number Management; SEMI P1 (Photomask); Oracle Agile PLM

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days the raw material can be stored from the date of manufacture or receipt before it is considered expired and must be quarantined or disposed of. Critical for photoresists, ALD precursors, and specialty chemicals with time-sensitive stability. Corresponds to SAP MARA.MHDRZ (shelf life in days).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MARA.MHDRZ; SEMI C1; ISO 9001

attributes.name: standard_price
attributes.description: Standard cost price per base unit of measure used for inventory valuation in SAP CO (Controlling) and FI (Financial Accounting). Used for WIP costing, variance analysis, and financial reporting. Corresponds to SAP MBEW.STPRS (standard price).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO - MBEW.STPRS; SOX Section 404; IFRS IAS 2 (Inventories)

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Categorical storage environment required for the raw material. Drives warehouse location assignment and storage area classification. Examples: cleanroom for bare silicon wafers, refrigerated for certain photoresists, nitrogen_purge for moisture-sensitive ALD precursors. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|refrigerated|frozen|cleanroom|nitrogen_purge|dark_storage|fireproof_cabinet — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SEMI C1; SEMI M1; GHS SDS Section 7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: storage_humidity_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable relative humidity percentage for storage of the raw material. Particularly critical for silicon wafers, photomasks, and hygroscopic chemicals where moisture exposure causes defects or degradation.
attributes.references: SEMI M1 (Silicon Wafer Standard); SEMI P1 (Photomask Standard); GHS SDS Section 7

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the raw material. Exceeding this threshold may degrade material quality, trigger safety hazards, or invalidate process qualification. Used for warehouse environmental compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SEMI C1; GHS SDS Section 7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the raw material. Used to configure environmental monitoring alerts in the warehouse management system and ensure compliance with material safety data sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: SEMI C1; GHS SDS Section 7; ISO 14001

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
